[P2] Balance hooks for discarded nested children

When early map/parallel completion closes checkpoint admission, a non-virtual child reaches this helper after already firing `onOperationStart`. It emits no checkpoint and this guard skips `onOperationEnd`, leaving plugins with an unbalanced lifecycle; for example, the execution OTel plugin omits the child span. Fire the end hook for newly executed uncheckpointed children on both success and failure, while excluding replay paths that already emitted it, and add an early-completion plugin regression test.
